messages:
lina-cs: Heads-up: Hyacinth Systems renewal window next Tue. Customer wants a 9-month term (start 2026-05-01), asks for 10% off and monthly billing. Onboarding ~68% (KMS attestation + sample ingest outstanding). Procurement requires EU vendor code + PO. DocuSign blocked by their procurement portal. Need pricing calc, KMS addendum, and signature fallback. cc @carlos-fin @meera-legal

josh-se: Seat count? Any ramp?

lina-cs: 14 seats initial, expect +2 by month 2.

carlos-fin: Baseline $160/seat/mo. Quick math: 14 * 160 * 9 = 20,160 pre-discount. 10% => 18,144 total. If billed monthly with discount that's 160*14*(1-0.10)=2,016/mo. Need PO with billing entity and vendor code to finalize.

meera-legal: We can do 9-month addendum. For KMS: accept customer-managed KMS if they sign addendum and provide attestation. Signature fallback: add clause "secure portal upload accepted where third-party e-sign is restricted". Need signatory name/title on PO.

andrea-enable: I'll schedule enablement the week after sign; need sample ingest by 2026-04-24. Will update first-week runbook.

esign-bot: DocuSign: Envelope 0xA7c created by lina-cs  Status: blocked (procurement policy)

lina-cs: I asked them to wet-sign and upload to secure portal. Customer said they'll wire payment and send PO EOD Mon.

carlos-fin: Wire ok. Please send PO + wire instructions to billing@redwood.com. Finance will accept single upfront invoice if they wire; otherwise monthly Net30.

josh-se: I'll hold the canary until enablement + payment confirmed. Ops can provision temporary Dedicated capacity for cutover if needed.

meera-legal: Action: I'll post draft 9-month addendum with KMS clause and signature fallback by EOD.

lina-cs: Plan recap: 1) Customer to upload wet-signed PO to portal by EOD Mon; 2) Legal to post addendum by EOD; 3) Finance to confirm wire/invoice cadence; 4) Enablement scheduled week after sign; 5) Josh to hold rollout until ingest passes. I'll update renewal tracker when PO is in.

carlos-fin: Ping billing@redwood.com when upload is done and I'll route to billing ops.

lina-cs: Thanks team 44d closing thread once PO & signed docs are uploaded.
